description: Speculative & long-term vision — Phase 14: DNA-to-culture mapping, audio/IPA & music playback, AI-powered insights (narrative, anomaly, hypothesis generation) over the shared graph, AR/VR, and the living-dataset workflow. Mostly greenfield; each story scopes to the delta over existing building blocks (haplogroup correlation, media-asset audio, Gemini client, languageStatus).

userStories.title: DNA-to-culture ancestry mapper
userStories.description: As a user, I want to upload my DNA results and see associated cultures, languages, and cuisines so I can explore my heritage — processed privately.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a client-side 23andMe/AncestryDNA file parser (all processing in-browser; nothing uploaded/stored)
Map extracted haplogroups to cultures/languages via HaplogroupFeature.associatedLanguageFamilyIds/associatedCivilizationIds and server/services/genetic-linguistic-correlation.ts
Render a 'your ancestors likely spoke / ate / lived among…' view with confidence and clear caveats
vitest tests cover the parser + mapping on synthetic fixtures; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: IPA pronunciation audio playback
userStories.description: As a learner, I want to hear IPA pronunciations so language data is audible, not just textual.
acceptanceCriteria: Add audio playback for IPA strings / word forms in phonology-panel.tsx and word-comparison.tsx (TTS/IPA synthesis or recorded clips via media-asset-service.ts)
Playback controls are accessible and respect reduced-motion/autoplay preferences
Graceful fallback when no audio is available
vitest/component tests cover the playback control; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: Music & instrument audio in the media gallery
userStories.description: As a user, I want to hear musical tradition and instrument clips so cultural media is richer.
acceptanceCriteria: Surface mediaType:'audio' assets (already supported in server/services/media-asset-service.ts) in CultureMediaGallery.tsx with an audio player
Instruments/music traditions link to their audio clips; player supports playlist/sequence
Attribution/provenance shown for each clip
component tests cover audio rendering; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: "Sound of a language family" sequence player
userStories.description: As a learner, I want to hear related languages in sequence (and reconstructed proto-forms) so I can perceive family resemblance.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a sequence player that plays pronunciations across a language family in genealogical order
Support optional reconstructed proto-language audio (e.g. Proto-Indo-European) where available, clearly labeled reconstructed/speculative
Reuse the IPA playback from US-002
component tests cover sequence ordering; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: AI 'explain the connection' narrative generator
userStories.description: As a user, I want an AI explanation of how two entities are connected so relationships are understandable.
acceptanceCriteria: Add an endpoint that, given two entities, traverses the shared graph (tasklist 16) + Datalog inference and uses the existing Gemini client to generate a sourced narrative explanation
Explanations cite the underlying edges/facts and their provenance; clearly labeled AI-generated
Handle no-path and low-confidence cases honestly
vitest tests mock the LLM + graph; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: Anomaly detection for unexpected cultural similarities
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want the system to surface unexpected cross-cultural similarities so I can find leads for undiscovered contact.
acceptanceCriteria: Add an analysis that scans the shared graph/cross-domain data for statistically unexpected similarities (shared motifs, pottery styles, haplogroup+trait co-occurrence) between distant cultures
Rank anomalies by surprise/confidence with supporting evidence and provenance
Results are clearly framed as hypotheses, not conclusions
vitest tests cover the scoring on fixtures; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: Automated hypothesis & site-location generation
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want generated hypotheses (including where undiscovered sites might be) so the tool suggests research directions.
acceptanceCriteria: Generate hypotheses from the graph (e.g. 'cultures A/B/C share pottery + haplogroup markers -> possible common ancestor') and predict likely undiscovered site regions from migration/settlement patterns
Each hypothesis carries evidence, confidence, and is clearly labeled speculative; distinct from the curated urheimat-hypotheses dataset
Predictions render as map overlays with uncertainty
vitest tests cover hypothesis generation on fixtures; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: AR historical-layer overlay
userStories.description: As a mobile user, I want to point my phone at a location and see historical layers so history is experienced in place.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a WebXR/AR mode that overlays historical map layers for the user's location on the camera view
Gracefully feature-detect and fall back on unsupported devices
Layers reuse the existing temporal map data
build/unit checks cover feature detection + layer selection; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: VR globe & virtual museum
userStories.description: As a user, I want an immersive 3D globe and 3D artifacts so I can explore space, time, and material culture.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a three.js/WebXR 3D globe with time-space fly-through following migration paths (deck.gl mesh layers are available)
Add a virtual museum rendering glTF/3D artifact models where public-domain models exist
Toggle between flat map, globe, and museum; degrade gracefully without WebXR
build/unit checks cover scene setup; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: Endangered-language dashboard & field-research workflow
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want preservation-status tracking and a field-update workflow so the dataset reflects living linguistic reality.
acceptanceCriteria: Add an endangered-language dashboard driven by the existing languageStatus field (living/endangered/extinct) with preservation metrics
Add a field-research update workflow (structured, attributed edits from researchers) building on the contribution pipeline
Status changes are versioned/changelogged (tasklist 18 US-010)
vitest tests cover status aggregation + field-update submission; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: Living dataset: discovery ingestion & DOI snapshots
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want ongoing discovery ingestion and citable snapshots so the dataset stays current and academically usable.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a workflow to ingest newly published discoveries (via culture-scrape scheduled acquisition, packages/culture-scrape/) with review
Produce periodic versioned dataset snapshots with DOIs (aligning with tasklist 18 US-011) and an annual release cadence
Freshness/versioning surfaced in the UI (building on data-freshness.ts)
vitest tests cover the ingestion + snapshot metadata; `npm run check` passes
